CANONICAL_NAME.value: willemt/raft -- a C implementation of the Raft consensus algorithm

VERSION.value: github.com/willemt/raft master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Raft (2014, Ongaro & Ousterhout): understandable distributed consensus -- leader election, log replication, and safety across crashing/partitioning nodes; willemt/raft is a widely-used embeddable C library of the core state machine

value.built_to: keep a replicated log consistent across a cluster of machines that crash, restart, and get partitioned -- by electing a leader and replicating entries only when a majority acknowledges
value.pressure: partial failure: nodes die, messages are lost or delayed, the network splits; the system must never present two leaders' conflicting histories as committed
value.success_means: a single consistent committed log despite up to (N-1)/2 failures; safety never violated, liveness restored when a majority reconnects

value.pressure: partial failure, message loss/delay, network partition, competing would-be leaders
value.failure_condition: split-brain: two leaders commit conflicting entries; the replicated state diverges and data is lost or corrupted

ANCESTRY.value: Raft (2014, Ongaro & Ousterhout): understandable distributed consensus -- leader election, log replication, and safety across crashing/partitioning nodes; willemt/raft is a widely-used embeddable C library of the core state machine

ancestry_edges.note: Raft; itself a redesign of Paxos for understandability
